provisional_statement: A Borel probability law on Real is stable under convolution and affine rescaling if and only if its characteristic function belongs to the standard alpha-stable family, with the alpha = 1 convention and all parameter bounds stated explicitly.
domain_and_universes: Planned Borel probability measures on Real, or real-valued random variables on probability spaces; exact Lean measure interfaces and universes remain open
quantifiers: mu : Borel probability law on Real
n or independent random variables with common law mu
positive scaling constants and real centering constants
parameters alpha, beta, scale, and location for the analytic form
hypotheses: the characteristic-function parameters obey their admissible ranges
the alpha = 1 and alpha != 1 formulas use one fixed Fourier and location convention
conclusion: The convolution/affine stability property is equivalent to the selected characteristic-function classification after the exact source variant is fixed
boundary_cases: alpha = 1 requires a separate logarithmic formula
alpha = 2 is the Gaussian branch and forces the corresponding skew term to disappear
zero scale gives a degenerate point mass and must be included or excluded explicitly
